plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Ubiquiti EdgeRouter (EdgeOS). It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, temperature, fan speed, power supply status, and interface traffic (HOST-RESOURCES, UCD-SNMP and UBNT-EdgeMAX MIBs, enterprise PEN 41112).
name: Router

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports per-core CPU load on the Ubiquiti EdgeRouter as a percentage (HOST-RESOURCES-MIB hrProcessorLoad, 1-minute average per core). Sustained high values indicate control-plane or forwarding load.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Memory utilisation of the Ubiquiti EdgeRouter, computed at collection as (memTotalReal - memAvailReal) / memTotalReal * 100 from the UCD-SNMP-MIB scalars.

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: Total physical memory of the Ubiquiti EdgeRouter in bytes (UCD-SNMP-MIB memTotalReal, scalar 1.3.6.1.4.1.2021.4.5.0, reported in kB and multiplied by 1024 at collection).

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: Used physical memory of the Ubiquiti EdgeRouter in bytes, computed at collection as memTotalReal - memAvailReal.

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: Available physical memory of the Ubiquiti EdgeRouter in bytes (UCD-SNMP-MIB memAvailReal, scalar 1.3.6.1.4.1.2021.4.6.0, reported in kB and multiplied by 1024 at collection).

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Temperature of each EdgeRouter thermometer (UBNT-EdgeMAX-MIB ubntThermTemperature, 1.3.6.1.4.1.41112.1.5.4.2.1.3), reported by the device in thousandths of a degree Celsius and divided by 1000 at collection; readings outside -40 to 150 °C are dropped. Only models with thermometers return rows.

metrics.name: device_fan_rpm
metrics.description: Rotation speed in RPM of each EdgeRouter fan (UBNT-EdgeMAX-MIB ubntFanRpm, 1.3.6.1.4.1.41112.1.5.5.2.1.3). Negative or implausible values are dropped. Fanless models return no rows.

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: Status of each EdgeRouter power supply (UBNT-EdgeMAX-MIB ubntPsuStatus, 1.3.6.1.4.1.41112.1.5.3.2.1.3), normalized at collection: on = 1 (normal), off = 2 (fault), standby = 3; unknown is dropped. Only models that expose the PSU table return rows.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
